svg.aria-label: Two panels in the plane of w and d, each with the domain of Proposition C.10 shaded orange, from w = minus 2/5 to 2/5 and d from 0 to 1/2 with w at most d, and level lines of the lower bound g at 0.01 to 0.06, labelled. In (a), for W and D separated along the secondary axis of W, the least value, about 0.0046, is marked at the vertex (0, 1/2); in (b), along the secondary axis of D, it is about 0.0047, at the vertex (minus 2/5, 1/2)
